column1: # The Chinese (Hong Kong) translations: the road editing (src/ui_edit.rs).
Knife (K): a click on a road cuts it there, as often as you like; the pieces' lengths shown at the cursor, on whole grid steps with grid snapping on — right-click or Esc: off
column2: 刀（K）：點擊道路即可在該處切開，次數不限；游標處顯示各段長度，開啟網格吸附時以整數格為準 — 右鍵或 Esc：關閉

column1: The angle step: what snapping comes to and what R turns by
column2: 角度步進：吸附的角度，以及 R 鍵的旋轉角度

column1: Snap headings to the angle step
column2: 將朝向吸附至角度步進

column1: Click two points to measure the distance and gradient between them (U) — right-click: off
column2: 點擊兩點以量度其間的距離與斜度（U） — 右鍵：關閉

column1: What you build follows the ground: roads, paths and tracks take its height (off: they run level from where they start). Only what is built from now on; nothing already there changes
column2: 你建造的東西會貼合地形：道路、小徑與軌道會取得其高度（關閉：從起點起保持水平）。只影響之後建造的東西，已有部分不變

column1: Branching a track off another makes a switch there
column2: 從另一條軌道分支時會在該處產生道岔
在道路交會處建立路口

column1: Line objects up with the nearest road (Shift: put it freely)
column2: 令物件與最近的道路對齊（Shift：自由放置）

column1: A click on one of it selects all of it, Ctrl + click one alone
column2: 點擊其中一項即選取全部，Ctrl + 點擊則只選取該項

column1: Keep these together: a click on one selects all, a drag moves all (Ctrl+G)
column2: 將它們綑在一起：點擊其中一項即選取全部，拖曳即可移動全部（Ctrl+G）

column1: Each one's outline made level with its foot, blending into the ground 3 m round it
column2: 令每個物件的底面與地面齊平，並在周圍 3 米內與地面融合

column1: The object chosen in the Objects tool's catalogue
column2: 在「物件」工具的目錄中所選的物件

column1: Every selected object turned its own random way (trees, bushes, rocks)
column2: 每個已選取物件各自隨機轉向（樹木、灌木、岩石）

column1: Each turned the way the nearest road runs beside it
column2: 各自朝向旁邊最近道路的方向

column1: Every selected object takes the heading of the one in the properties
column2: 每個已選取物件都採用屬性中顯示那個的朝向

column1: The road type chosen in the Roads tool's catalogue
column2: 在「道路」工具的目錄中所選的道路類型

column1: One chain of roads: from the height at one end to that at the other, evenly (a bridge, a ramp)
column2: 一條連續道路：由一端的高度到另一端的高度等分（橋樑、斜坡）

column1: Its lanes become AI paths of their own (the same lines, the same way) that the Logic tool's Edit existing bends, moves and deletes. The road keeps its look.
column2: 其車道成為獨立的 AI 路徑（相同的線、相同的方向），可用「邏輯」工具的「編輯現有路徑」彎曲、移動及刪除。道路外觀不變
端點（已接合的道路會跟隨）

column1: Banking across the road, %: positive lowers its right side (into a right bend)
column2: 道路橫向傾斜（%）：正值令右側降低（形成右彎）

column1: Both gradients to the straight climb between the ends' heights
column2: 兩端斜度按端點高度之間的直線上升調整

column1: For the AI and the player on one path (lane) of it, counted from 0: the view shows their numbers
column2: 供 AI 與玩家在其某一條路徑（車道）上使用，從 0 開始編號：畫面中會顯示其數字

column1: A fence, a row of houses, an avenue: the selection copied again and again, a step on each time
column2: 圍欄、一排房屋、林蔭道：選取部分會不斷複製，每次前進一步

column1: More than one: a grid (an orchard, a car park), each row a row step on
column2: 多於一列：形成格狀（果園、停車場），每列按列間距前進

column1: Tilted to the ground under it, the way it slopes forward and to the side (a fence, a bench or a shed on a hillside)
column2: 隨下方地形的傾斜而向前的側傾（斜坡上的圍欄、長椅或小屋）

column1: Heights along the ground again, smoothed so it climbs a hill rather than every bump (after shaping the ground or laying a height map over it); where a road not selected joins, its height is kept
column2: 重新依循地面高度，並平滑化使其順著山丘起伏而非每個小凸起（在塑造地形或鋪上高度圖之後）；與未選取道路接合之處則保留其高度

column1: Each starts where it ended: the traffic on it goes the other way (a one-way street, a track's direction), the road itself stays where it is
column2: 各自從上一個的終點開始：其上的交通方向相反（單行道、軌道方向），但道路本身位置不變

column1: A second track or the other carriageway: the selected splines copied alongside, bends kept exact, linked as they are
column2: 第二條軌道或另一條車行道：沿旁複製選取的樣條線，彎曲完全保留，並照樣連結

column1: Left and right of the way the road runs (its arrows with AI lanes shown)
column2: 道路行進方向的左側與右側（顯示其箭嘴與 AI 車道）

column1: For trams and electric trains: a wire spline laid on the selected track, piece for piece and linked (its height is the wire spline's own); the masts go in with Objects along the road
column2: 供電車及電力列車使用：在選取的軌道上一段接一段鋪設電線樣條線並連結（其高度為電線樣條線本身的高度）；電線桿以「沿路物件」加入

column1: No wire spline installed (one whose name says Fahrdraht, Oberleitung or wire)
column2: 未安裝電線樣條線（名稱含 Fahrdraht、Oberleitung 或 wire 者）

column1: Add a ground texture in the Paint tool first: the base ground is under everything
column2: 先在「塗抹」工具中新增地面貼圖：底層地面位於所有圖層之下

column1: A gravel verge, dirt by a track, grass along a path: the brush of the Paint tool touches it up afterwards
column2: 碎石路肩、軌道旁的泥地、小徑旁的草地：之後可用「塗抹」工具的畫筆修飾

column1: Each object leans with the road's gradient and banking (bays and arrows on the road); off, it stands upright
column2: 每個物件隨道路的斜度與橫傾而傾斜（路上的停車位與箭嘴）；關閉時則直立

column1: A text the row's objects show (@ starts a new line)
column2: 該列物件所顯示的文字（@ 開始新的一行）

column1: Pick an object (a lamp, a tree, a bollard) in the Objects tool's catalogue
column2: 在「物件」工具的目錄中選擇一個物件（燈柱、樹木、護柱）

column1: Right of the road's direction; negative: left
column2: 道路方向的右側；負值為左側

column1: Roundabout: click the centre, then the ring
column2: 圓環：先點擊中心，再點擊圓環

column1: A one-way ring of the chosen road type (pick a one-way road); roads inside are cut back to it and joined with junctions
column2: 以所選道路類型構成的單向圓環（請選擇單行道）；內部的道路會被切回至圓環，並以路口接合

column1: An even gradient from end to end, the ground left as it is; the rise to the end can be typed while drawing. Pillars: select the road and put them along it as objects.
column2: 首尾等斜，地面保持原樣；可於繪製時輸入升至終點的高度。橋墩：選取道路後以物件方式沿路放置

column1: Lights need three roads or more
column2: 燈號需要三條或以上的道路

column1: The main road is the pair of roads most in line; red-yellow 2 s, yellow 3 s, 2 s all red between
column2: 主路是最為平行的兩條道路；紅黃燈 2 秒，黃燈 3 秒，全紅 2 秒

column1: Makes the plate, its kerbs and lanes again for the roads as they are now
column2: 按目前道路形狀重新產生路面板、路緣與車道

column1: An object can take its state from another ([varparent]): a signal head shows a light of its crossing's program, a stop's display its stop.
column2: 物件可從另一物件取得狀態（[varparent]）：訊號燈頭顯示其路口程式的燈號，站牌的顯示屏顯示該站

column1: Takes its state from an object that is gone: IDCode
column2: 狀態取自已刪除的物件：IDCode

column1: Its light is not one of the crossing's: it stays dark
column2: 其燈光不屬於該路口的燈號：因此保持熄滅

column1: That object runs no traffic lights: link the head to a crossing with a light program
column2: 該物件沒有交通燈：請將燈頭連結至有燈光程式的路口

column1: A signal head: link it to its crossing to have it light
column2: 訊號燈頭：連結至其路口才會亮起

column1: Click the object in the view…(Esc)
Then click the object it is to take its state from (a crossing for a signal head)
column2: 然後點擊它要從中取得狀態的物件（訊號燈頭則是路口）
